title: Planned upgrade works – nbn Toowoomba (QLD) POI
current_summary: We have planned upgrade works on our network at the Toowoomba nbn point of interconnect. The work is scheduled between 12:00 am and 1:00 am AEST on Tuesday 17 November 2026. nbn services connected through Toowoomba may be disrupted for up to 20 minutes during this window.

cause.reason: Planned upgrade to a network port at the Toowoomba nbn point of interconnect.

updates.content: We have scheduled upgrade works at the Toowoomba nbn point of interconnect (POI). The work will take place between 12:00 am and 1:00 am AEST on Tuesday 17 November 2026. During this window, nbn services connected through the Toowoomba POI may be disrupted for up to 20 minutes while a network port is upgraded. We will keep this page updated if anything changes.
